name: Long
source: Once your childhood friend, Long is now your new fiancé—a role neither of you chose but must accept. Now, as he returns from his studies in the West to become the new Crown Prince, Long is no longer the boy he once was. Will this marriage offer a chance to heal the fractures of your past, or will it only deepen the divide between you?
